questions.questionText: What is the ultimate benefit of achieving complete verbal fluency under pressure?
questions.expectedAnswer: The ultimate benefit is the capacity to think, react, and converse with high speed, accuracy, and emotional resonance in any context.

flashcards.definition: The quality or condition of being able to speak easily, write accurately, and understand naturally.
flashcards.example: "With stage twelve completed, you have unlocked complete native fluency."
